title: Digging Deeper: Conversations in Fundamental Investing
description: A panel discussion at Sohn 2026 featuring a group of experienced investors— Andrew Bellas, Eduardo Marques, David Rosen, and Jonathan Lennon —moderated by Mitch Golden. The conversation focuses on investment strategies within the current market environment, including the impacts of AI and the persistence of value investing.
summary: The speaker argues that several specific stocks represent significant investment opportunities based on unique growth characteristics, attractive valuations, or potential for massive upside. Key positions include Carvana, which is expected to triple due to high growth and a low multiple of pre-tax free cash flow; Micron and SK Hynix, described as massive cash generators trading at reasonable earnings multiples; and Reddit, which could double or triple if included in an AI winning basket. Additionally, the speaker highlights Viatris as a stock with substantial potential to more than double or even become a 10-bagger within 12 months if certain drug assets are acquired or rescheduled.
